description: This PHP source file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class 'Language' within the OrangeHRM system, specifically for reporting purposes related to employee language skills. The class encapsulates logic to reference an employee by their employee number, retrieve their language data, and normalize it for reporting.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: A DTO class representing employee language data for reporting, capable of normalizing language details and accessing related employee language information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Language DTO with an employee number to reference employee language data.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the employee's language data into an array based on specified fields, using normalization.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Defines a mapping of field names to their corresponding getter methods in the Employee entity for extracting language information.
